note: Section 4.4.1: "Every SPD SHOULD have a nominal, final entry that matches anything that is otherwise unmatched, and discards it." Re-judged 2026-11-08 (independent auditor) after bf2e2d753c and 652591fc76 changed apply.go::applyConfig, releaseSPD and unmatched_xfrm_interface.go::installXFRMInterfaceEntries. applyConfig: on the first apply the node catch-all still goes in first (installUnmatched), then applyApplicationOverride (the RFC4301-4.4.1-8 setsockopt guard), then the IKE bypass; a refused guard returns with the catch-all in force and nothing else installed. On a reload the guard and the interface entries move ahead of every SPD change, so a refusal leaves the running SPD as it was. releaseSPD only adds a deferred releaseApplicationOverride after the catch-all leaves; the guard is no SPD entry, so the catch-all is still the last SPD entry removed and is still kept when warnSPDLeft reports a leftover. installXFRMInterfaceEntries now returns an error naming the interface when its catch-all is refused, skips that interface's if_id 0 exemptions in the same pass, and applyConfig returns that error after the prune: an interface SPD without its final entry is no longer reported applied. The prior finding (no tagged unit judged the per-interface SPDs) is resolved: TestInterfaceSPDCatchAllEntries (builder: six DISCARD entries at the if_id, ranked PriorityUnmatched below PriorityChildSA, unnarrowed), TestApplyInstallsInterfaceSPDCatchAllAndGuard (commit reaches it), TestReleaseRemovesInterfaceSPDAndGuard (release, node catch-all kept on a refused interface removal), TestRFC4301InterfaceSPDDiscardsUnmatchedInKernel (XfrmOutPolBlock rises at the if_id, a Child SA policy outranks it; vacuity leg first) are positives, and TestInterfaceSPDCatchAllInstallFailureFailsTheApply is a genuine negative (refused interface catch-all fails the apply on first apply and reload, no exemption hands it traffic). The node-wide half stays proven by TestRFC4301DefaultFinalSPDEntryDiscards, TestRFC4301FinalEntryIsUnderEveryZeSPDEntry (every write replayed, catch-all present and DISCARD whenever another Ze entry is live) and the negative TestRFC4301InboundClearPacketIsDiscardedByTheDefaultFinalEntry (kernel XfrmInPolBlock +1, not delivered). Test fixtures set ApplicationOverrideAllow or embed bypassDP's guard, so the new guard does not confound them. FINDING (weak, question 4): the row says Every SPD and carries no annotation, but two SPDs Ze populates have no final DISCARD entry: the VPP backend (vppPolicyInterface; no node-wide SPD, no interface catch-all, unmatched bypass only) and the kernel SPD holding the OSPFv3 RFC 4552 manual-key entries when no IKE engine applies (defaultDataplaneSource). The tags prove the XFRM IKE SPDs only, so tagging the whole row reads as the whole requirement proven; the same paths are the {gap} of RFC4301-5.2-1 and RFC4301-5.2-9. Fix: a {partial} annotation on this row (Tested: XFRM node-wide and per-interface SPDs of the IKE engine; Gap: VPP SPDs, OSPFv3 manual-key entries; Producer: vppPolicyInterface, defaultDataplaneSource), then a partial rejudge, or the missing final entries. Also: the mutant record on TestReleaseRemovesInterfaceSPDAndGuard (releaseSPD warnSPDLeft break) no longer verifies (producer-changed) and owes a re-take.
